origine_fr: En bas, 贝, le coquillage, la monnaie ; en haut, 化 (亻 et 匕), qui donnait le son mais se lit huà. Ce sont les richesses. Ce qui a de la valeur et s'échange : la marchandise.
origine_en: Below, 贝, a shell, money; on top, 化 (亻 and 匕), which gave the sound but is read huà. It means riches. What has value and is traded: goods.
